input_contract.positions: endpoint / middle / other endpoint; P01/P02/P03 or P03/P02/P01
input_contract.direction_fusion: arithmetic mean of forward and endpoint-reversed softmax scores
input_contract.preprocessing: independent whole-window mean removal and /2048 for each hit
input_contract.spectrum: per-hit RMS normalization, symmetric Hann, abs(rfft)/sample_count, fitted log1p compression

adoption_basis: User selected RMS normalization + log spectrum based on retrospective transfer study.
packaging_note: Training audit paths reduced to file names; hashes, fitted preparation and weights are unchanged. Full raw acquisition and experiment directories are not shipped.
